en.html:
A leader of the shogunate, the Kubou of Horigoe. Political circumstances, probably. Thinking about it, such a person relaxing at home was itself the strange situation.

She said she was confined over responsibility for Hachimangu, but that could not be swallowed whole either. Probably all maneuvering. Perhaps that maneuvering had produced results, making her return to Kamakura necessary.

en.html:
Chachamaru"Oh."
Kageaki"Your Excellency?"
Chachamaru"There, there. Machines coming out."
Chachamaru"Shoukyou, that one?"
Kageaki"Yes. Plainly from the Aputima line."
Kageaki"...Rather too plainly, I feel."
Chachamaru"No evidence of ingenuity. Surely not taking that into next year's domestic season."
Kageaki"Aputima is a masterpiece... but by now, outdated."
Chachamaru"Holding something back? These people do not understand fan service..."
Muramasa"Aputima, was that one in Kamakura also?"
Kageaki"Yes."
Muramasa"Looks different from that one."
Chachamaru"Where?"
Muramasa"The peculiar thing attached with the thrusters."
Chachamaru"The afterburner? ...Ah, right."
Kageaki"A midship. This... should alter the machine's balance."
Chachamaru"Quietly interesting work. Earlier statement withdrawn."
Kageaki"The drive may be belt also."
Chachamaru"Possible. They have done that modification before."

en.html:
Kageaki"Will midship and belt drive become the mainstream from here?"
Chachamaru"Apun prefers chain drive. Stretches, shorten it. Belt stretches, finished, no?"
Muramasa"...?"
Kageaki"I hear machines with tension-adjustment mechanisms will appear shortly. Still, I also prefer chain to belt."
Chachamaru"Bhai understands the poetry."
Kageaki"Yes."
Chachamaru"Think normally: metal over rubber."
Kageaki"Naturally."
Chachamaru"Chain-Drive Alliance formed."
Kageaki"No. My greatest love is shaft drive."
Chachamaru"You Tamura child!!"
Kageaki"My apologies."
Muramasa"? ...?"
Chachamaru"And speaking of them, Tamura has arrived. What is that?"
Kageaki"...A new work, apparently. I have never seen it."
Chachamaru"Hmm... But does it not resemble something?"
Kageaki"............"

en.html:
Chachamaru"Main frame... rather close to that Avenge."
Kageaki"...Now you mention it."
Chachamaru"Carried that outrageous machine concept forward? Tamura cannot be dismissed either."
Kageaki"The running gear is completely changed."
Muramasa"Listen..."
Chachamaru"Looks like soft suspension."
Kageaki"Shock absorption seems good... but would that not cause difficulty in cornering?"
Chachamaru"Maybe that is what they mean to test today."
Kageaki"I see."
Muramasa"...Mido..."
Kageaki"Hm!? Your Excellency, over there!"
Chachamaru"Hm? That is Tomii. New-entry team only adding to the crowd, no need to—"
Chachamaru"WHAT!? Yutz-steel double-deck frame, center differential, BELT DRIVE!?"
Kageaki"And that is a torque splitter!"
Chachamaru"Full equipment!? Where did that company get such development capacity? Apun thought snap-fit models were their one accomplishment!"
Kageaki"Entirely beyond expectation."
Muramasa"............Hellooo............"
Kageaki"Machine name—Trespasser? It may be the dark horse today."
Chachamaru"Depending on the racer, no telling how far it goes. Now things are interesting!"
Kageaki"Yes, very much so."

en.html: She was not looking at me. She faced the circuit, where staff hurried about preparing for the next race. Yet I knew. Chachamaru Ashikaga was laughing. Not ironically. Not mockingly. Simply at the amusement of hearing a well-made jest. ...A low chuckle in her throat. I had to question her. What did she know? Ask now, and perhaps she would speak the truth. For some reason, I felt that. I ought to ask.◆ ...For some reason, I could not. Why? No, there was no question. Know the truth could be obtained, yet refuse to ask—obviously because I did not want the truth. I knew by intuition. Hear it, know it, and that would be the end.
en.text:
She was not looking at me. She faced the circuit, where staff hurried about preparing for the next race.

Yet I knew.

Chachamaru Ashikaga was laughing.
Not ironically. Not mockingly.

Simply at the amusement of hearing a well-made jest.
...A low chuckle in her throat.

I had to question her.
What did she know?

Ask now, and perhaps she would speak the truth.

For some reason, I felt that.

I ought to ask.◆

...For some reason, I could not.

Why?
No, there was no question.

Know the truth could be obtained, yet refuse to ask—obviously because I did not want the truth.

I knew by intuition.
Hear it, know it, and that would be the end.

ja.html: 少女は俺を見ていない。 　次のレースに備えるため会場スタッフが走り回る、 サーキットの方へ顔を向けている。 　それでもわかった。 　足利茶々丸は笑っている。 　皮肉にではなく。嘲るようでもなく。 　ただ、出来の良い諧謔・・・・・・・を聞いたおかしさを。 　……喉の奥でくつくつと、笑っている。 　俺は問い質さねばならなかった。 　何を知っているのか、と。 　今問えば、彼女は真実を口にするかもしれない。 　どうしてか、そう思う。 　問うべきなのだ。◆ 　……どうしてか、それができない。 　どうして？ 　いや、疑問など無い。 　真実を得られるとわかっていて、問いを口にしない のは、真実が欲しくないから・・・・・・・・・・に決まっている。 　俺は直観しているのだ。 　それを聞き、それを知れば、最後おわりなのだと。
ja.text:
少女は俺を見ていない。
　次のレースに備えるため会場スタッフが走り回る、
サーキットの方へ顔を向けている。

　それでもわかった。

　足利茶々丸は笑っている。
　皮肉にではなく。嘲るようでもなく。

　ただ、出来の良い諧謔・・・・・・・を聞いたおかしさを。
　……喉の奥でくつくつと、笑っている。

　俺は問い質さねばならなかった。
　何を知っているのか、と。

　今問えば、彼女は真実を口にするかもしれない。

　どうしてか、そう思う。

　問うべきなのだ。◆

　……どうしてか、それができない。

　どうして？
　いや、疑問など無い。

　真実を得られるとわかっていて、問いを口にしない
のは、真実が欲しくないから・・・・・・・・・・に決まっている。

　俺は直観しているのだ。
　それを聞き、それを知れば、最後おわりなのだと。
